candidates.source_name: Věstník veřejných zakázek (VVZ) — NIPEZ, MMR ČR
candidates.why_relevant: Single national gazette where ALL Czech contracting entities, including sectoral/utility ones (ČD, Správa železnic, ČEZ group, Letiště Praha, DPP, vodárny) must publish contract notices, award notices and modifications above thresholds. Sectoral (utility) contracts are flagged as 'sektorová veřejná zakázka' and are the only systematic way to see utility buyers of payment acceptance / treasury services. Searchable by CPV (66110000 banking services, 66172000 financial transaction processing, 30162000/30144200 ticket/terminal equipment, 48000000 IT).
candidates.legal_status: official public register, open publication mandated by Act 134/2016 Sb.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled structured search by CPV code + contracting-entity IČO list; harvest notice forms (F02/F03/F05/F06 equivalents) and award notices; store notice ID, buyer IČO, CPV, value, winner.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs-language search on gazette + CPV banking services; snowballed from portal-vz.cz
queries_used: Věstník veřejných zakázek vestnikverejnychzakazek.cz sektorová zakázka CPV 66110000 bankovní služby

candidates.source_name: NEN — Národní elektronický nástroj

Full ZD is where technical requirements for card acceptance, POS terminals, payment gateways and treasury/banking services are actually specified.
candidates.access_status: public browsing; some documents may require registration
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Search by CPV and keyword; download ZD attachments where anonymous access permitted; track buyer profiles of ČD, SŽ, hospitals, health insurers.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from NIPEZ / portal-vz.cz

negative_findings.description: No dedicated portal or register exists that isolates 'sectoral/utility contracting entity' contracts for payment or banking services in CZ. Under Act 134/2016 Sb. the concept of 'sektorový zadavatel' was replaced by 'sektorová veřejná zakázka', so the sectoral character is an attribute of an individual notice, not of a separate publication channel.
negative_findings.result_summary: Confirmed via MMR's portal-vz.cz Q&A; sectoral contracts are published in the general Věstník veřejných zakázek and on ordinary buyer profiles.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must filter by buyer IČO + CPV rather than expect a sectoral-specific feed; otherwise sectoral buyers will be systematically missed or double-counted.

negative_findings.description: Searching in English for a Czech Railways ticketing/payment-gateway award notice on TED returned only generic railway-engineering and rolling-stock notices, no payment/ticketing award.
negative_findings.result_summary: EN-language TED searching did not surface the target notice; Czech-language searching on the ČD buyer profile is the more productive route.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms EN-only monitoring is insufficient for this cell — many payment-related sectoral contracts are below EU thresholds or described only in Czech.

negative_findings.description: For water utilities (vodárny a kanalizace), Czech-language searching for procurement of payment collection / card acceptance returned only customer-facing payment-method pages (PVK, OVAK, SčVK, VAK Mladá Boleslav, Vodárna Plzeň), not tenders.
negative_findings.result_summary: No vodárna tender for payment acceptance located in this pass; only descriptions of accepted payment channels (bankovní inkaso, SIPO, QR platba, SAZKA terminals, cards at customer centres).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Many water utilities are majority-private (Veolia/Suez-owned operating companies) and therefore may fall outside the procurement regime entirely, meaning their payment-acceptance sourcing is invisible in tender data and must be inferred from customer pages and the contract register.

negative_findings.description: For several commercial e-tools (Tender Arena, E-ZAKAZKY.CZ, podo.fen.cz, najdivz.cz) the terms of service for automated crawling were not read in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Public browsing is stated as possible without registration for Tender Arena, but robots.txt/ToS were not checked for any of these hosts.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Automated collection could breach ToS; a legal/robots review is required before scheduling crawlers on private profile hosts, whereas VVZ, NEN, TED and smlouvy.gov.cz are safe open-data routes.

negative_findings.description: The historically canonical gazette domain vestnikverejnychzakazek.cz was superseded by vvz.nipez.cz following an operator change in April 2023.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both domains still appear in search results and in older documents; the legacy one should be treated as unverified/legacy rather than dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any monitoring configuration or historical URL set pointing at the old domain must be re-pointed, and archived links may need resolution through the new system.

coverage_gaps.description: Regional/municipal transport undertakings (dopravní podniky in Brno, Ostrava, Plzeň, Olomouc, Liberec, Ústí, České Budějovice, etc.) and the integrated-transport organisers (ROPID, IDSK, KORDIS, IDOK) were not individually enumerated, yet each is a sectoral entity tendering EOC/contactless card acceptance.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build an explicit IČO roster of all Czech dopravní podniky plus IDS organisers and register them for VVZ/Hlídač monitoring on CPV 30144200/34970000/48810000/66172000.

coverage_gaps.description: Large state/teaching hospitals (VFN, FN Motol, FN Brno, IKEM, ÚVN and the direktly-managed 'přímo řízené organizace' of the Ministry of Health) were not individually mapped to buyer profiles in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Obtain MZ ČR's list of directly managed organisations and resolve each to its buyer profile (E-ZAK/NEN/Tender Arena), then keyword-monitor for terminals, kiosks, cash handling and banking services.

coverage_gaps.description: Health insurers beyond VZP, ZP MV ČR and OZP (ČPZP 205, VoZP 201, RBP 213, ZPŠ 209) were not resolved to buyer profiles; also Česká pošta (state-owned, SIPO operator and a major cash/payment node) was not covered in this cell's pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Resolve the remaining insurers' profiles and add Česká pošta, s.p. as a distinct high-priority buyer/actor; SIPO makes it structurally central to utility and insurer collections.

coverage_gaps.description: No CPV code list has been validated against actual Czech notices for payment-acceptance/treasury subject matter.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Empirically derive the CPV set by reverse-lookup from known contracts (e.g. the DPP terminal contract, the published acquiring contracts in ISRS) rather than assuming 66110000 alone.

coverage_gaps.description: Below-threshold and exempted purchases (VZMR — veřejné zakázky malého rozsahu) by sectoral entities are largely invisible in the gazette, and payment-acceptance deals are often revenue-share rather than fixed-price, which can keep them under thresholds.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat Registr smluv as the primary discovery channel for these, since the contract itself must still be published above 50k CZK; supplement with buyer-profile VZMR sections.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language coverage of this cell is structurally thin: only TED and a few commercial aggregators publish in EN, and no EN term reliably maps to 'odbavovací systém' or 'akceptace platebních karet'.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Maintain a cs→en glossary (odbavovací systém = fare collection/ticketing system; akceptace platebních karet = card acquiring/acceptance; platební brána = payment gateway; platební styk = payment services/transactions; inkaso = direct debit; sektorová zakázka = utilities contract) and run all primary monitoring in Czech.

brief: For Czech state-owned and sectoral (utility) contracting entities, there is no dedicated sectoral tender channel: since Act 134/2016 Sb. the sectoral character attaches to the individual contract, so everything flows through the national gazette (vvz.nipez.cz, formerly vestnikverejnychzakazek.cz), NEN, TED for above-threshold notices, and each entity's own buyer profile — which in this cell is fragmented across Tender Arena (České dráhy Z0003016, Letiště Praha Z0005204, VZP), E-ZAK instances (Správa železnic, regional hospitals), and E-ZAKAZKY.CZ (health insurers ZP MV ČR, OZP). The single richest source is Registr smluv (smlouvy.gov.cz), where the actual 'smlouva o akceptaci platebních karet' texts and their pricing annexes are published, with Hlídač státu as the best per-IČO aggregation layer and ÚOHS decisions as the best qualitative view of contested payment/ticketing procurements. Payment-acceptance deals with these buyers are frequently revenue-share and below threshold (the DPP contactless-terminal contract with Bankovní informační technologie/ČSOB and Mikroelektronika is the benchmark case), so tender-only monitoring will systematically under-count and must be paired with contract-register sweeps. Main remaining gaps are actor-level: regional dopravní podniky and IDS organisers, ministry-managed hospitals, the smaller health insurers and Česká pošta are not yet mapped to profiles.
